actions.action: Replant the basil in very moist potting soil and place it in the shade
When replanting, lift the plants out with as much of the root ball as possible instead of pulling them
Post a photo of the pot with the plants still in place

verdict.reason: The answer implies transplant damage from roots pulled without their root ball but never clearly names transplant shock; its advice to replant in very moist soil in shade roughly parallels the water-glass recovery without matching it, and nothing it suggests is likely to harm the plant.
